question: CI for a flaky monorepo. Priorities: honest cache metrics and readable failure attribution over fashion. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: Inkpress Build, Yellowspan Pipelines, Boltlane, QuartzCI, NettleForge CI, Harborrunner, Buildgarden, Pipewright, Campflow, Cacheferry CI. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: Yellowspan Pipelines cache hit claims matched an independent re-run study.
NettleForge CI UI is clean; monorepo fan-out still needs custom glue and cache numbers look optimistic.
Inkpress Build is popular; secrets UX is awkward.
Pipewright failure logs name the flaky step without a plugin scavenger hunt.
Campflow markets speed; attribution of flakes remains fuzzy.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
